def _curve_profile_regularity_type_record(value):
    """Read actual type metadata without invoking a foreign metaclass hook."""
    from .arc_profile_native_plan import _require

    cls = type(value)
    module = type.__dict__["__module__"].__get__(cls)
    name = type.__dict__["__qualname__"].__get__(cls)
    _require(
        type(module) is str
        and type(name) is str
        and 1 <= len(module) <= 128
        and 1 <= len(name) <= 128,
        "native_type_metadata_unavailable",
    )
    return {"module": module, "qualname": name}

    rep, owners, surfaces, item, records, *, event, label

    """Collect only stored advisory metadata; never query a geometric range."""
    from .arc_profile_native_plan import _require

    payload = {
        "surface1": None,
        "surface2": None,
        "location2": None,
        "continuity_value": None,
        "continuity_name": None,
        "continuity_type": None,
    }
    item["regularity"] = payload
    field = "enum_type_binding"
    try:
        from OCP.GeomAbs import GeomAbs_Shape

        for name in ("surface1", "surface2"):

                "surface_fields": None,
            }
            payload[name] = slot
            field = f"{name}.type"
            kind = None if owner is None else owner.DynamicType().Name()
            slot["surface_fields"] = {"kind": kind}
            _require(
                type(kind) is str and kind in ("Geom_Plane", "Geom_CylindricalSurface"),
                "unsupported_native_surface_metadata",
            )
            field = f"{name}.fields"
            slot["surface_fields"] = _curve_profile_surface_record(owner)
            matches = [index for index, known in enumerate(surfaces) if known is owner]
            if not matches:
                field = f"{name}.surface_index"
                _require(len(surfaces) < 8, "native_representation_limit")
                surfaces.append(owner)
                matches = [len(surfaces) - 1]
            slot["surface_index"] = matches[0]
        field = "location2"
        payload["location2"] = _curve_profile_location_record(rep.Location2())
        field = "continuity"
        continuity = rep.Continuity()
        field = "continuity_type"
        payload["continuity_type"] = _curve_profile_regularity_type_record(continuity)
        _require(type(continuity) is GeomAbs_Shape, "invalid_native_regularity_enum")
        field = "continuity_value"
        value = int(continuity)
        payload["continuity_value"] = value
        names = (
            "GeomAbs_C0",
            "GeomAbs_G1",
            "GeomAbs_C1",
            "GeomAbs_G2",
            "GeomAbs_C2",
            "GeomAbs_C3",
            "GeomAbs_CN",
        )
        _require(type(value) is int and 0 <= value < len(names), "invalid_native_regularity_enum")
        payload["continuity_name"] = names[value]
    except Exception as exc:
        event(
            "raw_generated_regularity_metadata_failure",
            {
                "role": label,
                "unavailable_field": field,
                "exception_type": _curve_profile_regularity_type_record(exc),
                "representations": tuple(records) + (item,),
            },
        )
        raise
    return payload

def _generated_regularity_grammar(item, surfaces, owner_roles):
    """Keep the exact two-owner advisory variant separate from geometric records."""
    _require(
        item["range"] == ()
        and type(item["range"]) is tuple
        and item["curve3d"] is None
        and type(item["pcurves"]) is tuple
        and item["pcurves"] == ()
        and item["owner_roles"] == ()
        and item["surface_index"] is None
        and item["surface_fields"] is None
        and not item["surface_is_retained"],
        "invalid_native_representation",
    )
    record = item["regularity"]
    _keys(
        record,
        (
            "surface1",
            "surface2",
            "location2",
            "continuity_value",
            "continuity_name",
            "continuity_type",
        ),
    )
    value, name = record["continuity_value"], record["continuity_name"]
    names = (
        "GeomAbs_C0",
        "GeomAbs_G1",
        "GeomAbs_C1",
        "GeomAbs_G2",
        "GeomAbs_C2",
        "GeomAbs_C3",
        "GeomAbs_CN",
    )
    _require(
        type(value) is int
        and 0 <= value < len(names)
        and type(name) is str
        and name == names[value],
        "invalid_native_regularity",
    )
    native_type = record["continuity_type"]
    _keys(native_type, ("module", "qualname"))
    _require(
        all(type(text) is str and 1 <= len(text) <= 128 for text in native_type.values()),
        "invalid_native_regularity",
    )
    for key in ("surface1", "surface2"):
        slot = record[key]
        _keys(slot, ("surface_index", "owner_roles", "surface_fields"))
        owner, roles = slot["surface_index"], slot["owner_roles"]
        _require(type(owner) is int and 0 <= owner < 8, "invalid_native_representation")
        _require(
            type(roles) is tuple
            and len(roles) == 1
            and type(roles[0]) is str
            and roles[0] in owner_roles,
            "native_generated_owner_changed",
        )
        _generated_surface_grammar(slot["surface_fields"])
        association = (roles, slot["surface_fields"])
        if owner in surfaces:
            _require(surfaces[owner] == association, "native_generated_owner_changed")
        else:
            # Check before either slot is inserted, including malformed inputs.
            _require(len(surfaces) < 8, "native_representation_limit")
            _require(owner == len(surfaces), "invalid_native_representation")
            surfaces[owner] = association
    _require(
        record["surface1"]["surface_index"] != record["surface2"]["surface_index"]
        and record["surface1"]["owner_roles"] != record["surface2"]["owner_roles"],
        "native_generated_owner_changed",
    )

    context. No coplanarity, straightness, root or trigonometric gate is added.

    slots = tuple(record[key] for key in ("surface1", "surface2"))
